# Private Lua 5.4.7 build dependency

This workspace-local fork contains Lua 5.4.7 source and build logic used by
the PICO-8 and TIC-80 machine bundles. It is not a published GlassVM contract
crate. The retained upstream Lua and `lua-src` licensing notices are in
`LICENSE`.

GlassVM's local interpreter changes are documented in
`docs/internal/LUA_RUNTIME_PATCH.md` in the machine repository.
